audit: offline scoring sensitivity, not truth or quality-loss estimate
note: 69 original-native-judge records reuse the exact same answer and original score, so they are not independent before-after experiments. There are no original-native-judge heldout answers in the deadline set. Removing rule-scored pairs changes the sample as well as the score method. Uniform-rule regrading is a sensitivity analysis on identical works; it does not establish which scoring method is accurate.
